prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity restrained dark desktop personal portfolio comp, 1536 by 1024 landscape
Primary request: Design a subtle, non-marketing personal website for Colton Spurgin as a quiet record. A short introduction and a factual chronology must do the work without announcing a brand concept.
Scene/backdrop: flat front-facing website screenshot on matte near-black
Subject: Colton is a software developer, Air Force NCO, research assistant, and UWF senior studying artificial intelligence; he graduates December 2026
Style/medium: calm modern web typography, small labels, generous negative space, thin rules, muted blue-gray accent, no visible theme or metaphor
Composition/framing: a simple top bar shows Colton Spurgin at left and Work, Background, Notes, Contact at right. Below, a fixed left column occupying about forty percent of the viewport contains the normal-size heading “Hi, I’m Colton.” followed by: “I’m a software developer, Air Force NCO, research assistant, and senior at UWF studying artificial intelligence. I graduate in December 2026.” Then: “Right now I lead development on an internship project and help with university research. After graduation, I want to keep building software and pursue a master’s degree.” Add plain GitHub, LinkedIn, Email links. The right column is one continuous factual record with Current first: Lead software developer intern; Air Force NCO; Research assistant; UWF · AI specialization · December 2026. Then Selected work appears as four spacious horizontal rows with small year or status, title, one-sentence description, and Source or Report link. Bork: “A dog-themed social app built with TypeScript and Next.js.” VeLLM: “A work-in-progress Tauri client for self-hosted Ollama models.” Traveling Salesman benchmarks: “A C++ framework comparing exact and heuristic approaches.” Home lab: “Ansible automation for Proxmox, Docker, and Linux.” Use one slim vertical record line with small square position marks as the only signature detail. No button.
Color palette: matte black #0d0f10, warm light gray #d7d5cf, steel gray #777d80, muted blue-gray #8096a8
Materials/textures: flat screen color, hairline dividers, tiny status squares; no physical texture
Text (verbatim): “Colton Spurgin”; “Work”; “Background”; “Notes”; “Contact”; “Hi, I’m Colton.”; “I’m a software developer, Air Force NCO, research assistant, and senior at UWF studying artificial intelligence. I graduate in December 2026.”; “Right now I lead development on an internship project and help with university research. After graduation, I want to keep building software and pursue a master’s degree.”; “GitHub”; “LinkedIn”; “Email”; “Current”; “Lead software developer intern”; “Air Force NCO”; “Research assistant”; “UWF · AI specialization · December 2026”; “Selected work”; “Bork”; “A dog-themed social app built with TypeScript and Next.js.”; “VeLLM”; “A work-in-progress Tauri client for self-hosted Ollama models.”; “Traveling Salesman benchmarks”; “A C++ framework comparing exact and heuristic approaches.”; “Home lab”; “Ansible automation for Proxmox, Docker, and Linux.”; “Source”; “Report”
Constraints: ordinary language; normal-size headings; clearly usable dark website; accurate, human, and easy to scan; no promotional call to action; no logo, portrait, slogan, invented employer names, metrics, awards, testimonials, or research specifics
Avoid: marketing landing page, oversized hero type, visual metaphor, themed interface, card grid, bento grid, neon, cyberpunk, terminal UI, cockpit, glassmorphism, gradients, decorative illustrations, rounded pills, heavy texture, 3D mockup, browser chrome, watermark
